superseded_material_text.notes: The source measured a natural Windham, Vermont specimen by electron microprobe. No composition-specific atomic-position refinement is reported, so atom_sites is intentionally empty. The ambient lattice gives 321.7583 A^3, independently confirming the published EOS cell basis and V0=321.77 A^3.

reference.title: Toward an internally consistent pressure scale
reference.source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

recalculation.notes: Figure 3 provides neither row-wise Pt volumes nor a numerical P-V table, so the reported pressures cannot be independently recalculated.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the free-access publisher article; LitCurate was used only for discovery and candidate enumeration.

primary_source_check.finding: The source explicitly reports the composition-specific 300 K trigonal Fe-dolomite BM3 with V0 and K0 fitted and K0'=4 fixed.
primary_source_check.record_note: Coefficients from Discussion paragraph 11; Figure 3 and the Discussion identify the cell volumes as 300 K.

primary_data_check.finding: Seven separable marker centers are bundled; the article and auxiliary files provide no numerical pressure-volume table.

independent_refit.method: Figure-marker audit with unweighted pressure residuals; V0 and K0 free and K0'=4 fixed
independent_refit.assessment: The low-resolution raster does not reproduce the source regression weights or the very small printed errors, but all seven markers follow the published curve within 0.70 GPa; the digitized refit is diagnostic and does not replace the source coefficients.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Experimental Procedure, paragraphs 5-6; Discussion, paragraphs 10-11; Figure 3.
parameter_provenance.equation: Discussion paragraph 11: third-order Birch-Murnaghan equation of state.
parameter_provenance.temperature_ref: Figure 3 and Discussion identify the cell volumes as 300 K.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Low-pressure trigonal Fe-dolomite observations before the approximately 17 GPa transition.

superseded_record_text.notes: Parenthetical parameter errors are preserved as printed; the confidence convention, covariance, row-wise uncertainties, and source fitting weights are not reported.
